info.title: The words of a pin line

PIN_VERDICTS.description: The verdict words of a pin: the value of its verdict key, what the qualification of the pinned bytes said. A pin with no verdict was learned on first use and carries no judgment.

oneOf.title: inProcess
oneOf.description: Qualified to run in a worker that other plugins share.
oneOf.x-text: Qualified to run in a worker that other plugins share.

oneOf.title: isolated
oneOf.description: Qualified to run, in a worker of its own.
oneOf.x-text: Qualified to run, in a worker of its own.

oneOf.title: refused
oneOf.description: Failed qualification: the pin records the bytes, a host should not load them.
oneOf.x-text: Failed qualification: the pin records the bytes, a host should not load them.

PIN_POOLS.description: The pool words of a pin: the value of its pool key, whether the plugin's qualification measured the CLAP thread pool real-time safe and faster at the quantum. A plugin with no word runs serial.

oneOf.title: cores
oneOf.description: Its worker starts with the thread pool on, one helper per core of its cpu set but one, and no other plugin shares the worker.
oneOf.x-text: Its worker starts with the thread pool on, one helper per core of its cpu set but one, and no other plugin shares the worker.

oneOf.title: off
oneOf.description: Measured, and not faster or not safe with the pool: the worker keeps no option.
oneOf.x-text: Measured, and not faster or not safe with the pool: the worker keeps no option.

PIN_KEYS.description: The keys of the optional words of a pin line, each this key, an equals sign and its value. Each appears at most once, in either order; a word with any other key is not a pin's.

oneOf.title: verdict
oneOf.description: The qualification verdict of the pinned bytes, a word of PIN_VERDICTS.
oneOf.x-text: The qualification verdict of the pinned bytes, a word of PIN_VERDICTS.

oneOf.title: pool
oneOf.description: The thread pool word of the pinned bytes, a word of PIN_POOLS.
oneOf.x-text: The thread pool word of the pinned bytes, a word of PIN_POOLS.

PIN_CHANGES.description: What counts as changed, the words of the pin_changed event: a pin holds the digests of the plugin's files and the fingerprint of its parameter layout, and only these two differ from it. Anything else about a plugin, its name or its version included, changes no pin.

oneOf.title: files
oneOf.description: A pinned file is gone, or its bytes no longer have the digest the pin holds.
oneOf.x-text: A pinned file is gone, or its bytes no longer have the digest the pin holds.

oneOf.title: layout
oneOf.description: The plugin's parameter layout no longer has the fingerprint the pin holds.
oneOf.x-text: The plugin's parameter layout no longer has the fingerprint the pin holds.
